exposure: gas used for multiple-breath washout (sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) and nitrogen (N2))
device used for multiple-breath washout (Exhalyzer D, Innocor, Respiratory Mass Spectrometer (RMS))
participant health status (healthy controls, cystic fibrosis)
cohort: The study participants included healthy controls and individuals with cystic fibrosis who completed multiple-breath washout trials.
finding: N2 multiple-breath washout results for breath number and lung clearance index were consistently higher than SF6 multiple-breath washout results in both healthy controls and patients with cystic fibrosis, with the difference being greater in more advanced disease.
